title: TSA/FBI Threat Check — No Active Advisory

transcript.speaker: FBI-DC
transcript.text: TSA Supervisor Reed, this is FBI Special Agent Marquez, calling from the Joint Terrorism Task Force in Lakeport. We’ve just received your request for a threat assessment on NCIA.

transcript.speaker: TSA-NCIA-1
transcript.text: Agent Marquez, thank you for the callback. We’re currently running a baseline threat check on a prior alert received via ProtonMail. Is there any active intelligence on NCIA?

transcript.speaker: FBI-DC
transcript.text: Negative, Supervisor. No credible threat advisories for North Coast International Airport at this time. The FBI has no open case on NCIA, and no known threats involving any known or suspected actors.

transcript.speaker: FBI-DC
transcript.text: TSA’s threat level remains ELEVATED (Bravo). That’s unchanged. We’re not flagging any new activity or pattern that would suggest an imminent risk to your facility.

transcript.speaker: TSA-NCIA-1
transcript.text: Understood. Is there any way we could get a formal file opened if we identify a suspect later?

transcript.speaker: FBI-DC
transcript.text: Yes — absolutely. We’ll open a case file on any individual you identify as a potential threat actor. But we need a name, a descriptor, or a known link to an incident. No leads, no file.

transcript.speaker: TSA-NCIA-1
transcript.text: Got it. We’ll keep you posted if we get a name. Thank you for the update.

voiceStyles.TSA-NCIA-1: Man in his 50s, steady, professional, faint radio static
